item.title: Week 10: Texans at Browns
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: HOU -4.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model CLE 47% vs. market 36% | On paper this one is close: Houston's best edge is to win through the air (Houston ranks 6th in EPA per dropback, +0.22), while Cleveland's best counter is to break tackles (Cleveland ranks 4th in broken tackles per touch, 6.5%). Under center, C.J. Stroud ranks 6th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Deshaun Watson ranks 24th; x-factor: Dalton Schultz averages 3.9 yards of separation, 6th of 76, and Cleveland's pass defense ranks 13th. The model favors Houston at 53%, mostly on starting QB (2.3 pts) and passing matchup (2.1 pts).
